tools.name: b2b_enrich_person
tools.description: Enrich a public LinkedIn person profile by handle or URL without cookies (10 Credits = $0.001 base / $0.0004 Business, 0 Credits on 404). Returns full career timeline, education, skills, headline, current employer, location, and follower count.

tools.name: b2b_enrich_company
tools.description: Resolve any LinkedIn company slug, URL, or corporate domain (e.g. "stripe.com") into verified headcount, industry, headquarters, organization ID, specialties, and website (10 Credits, 0 Credits on 404).

tools.name: b2b_search_decision_makers
tools.description: Search B2B decision-makers and company employees filtered by employer slug/domain, job title seniority (VP, CTO, Founder), keyword, and location (2 Credits per returned person, 0 Credits when empty).

tools.name: b2b_get_person_posts
tools.description: Retrieve recent public LinkedIn posts, commentary, and engagement metrics (likes, comments, reposts) for an executive handle (10 Credits per call).

tools.name: b2b_get_company_posts
tools.description: Retrieve official LinkedIn company feed posts, product launches, and engagement metrics for a target company (10 Credits per call).

tools.name: b2b_search_posts
tools.description: Search public LinkedIn posts by buying-intent keyword or category topic (2 Credits per post returned, 0 Credits when empty).

tools.name: b2b_search_hiring_signals
tools.description: Search active LinkedIn company job openings by company, role keyword, location, and remote flag to detect hiring velocity and technographic intent (2 Credits per job returned, 0 Credits when empty).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "b2b_enrich_person" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: b2b_get_person_posts, b2b_get_company_posts, b2b_search_posts · Public sink: b2b_search_posts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: b2b_get_person_posts, b2b_get_company_posts, b2b_search_posts · Public sink: b2b_search_posts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
